segments_b.text: What do you become when there's no light left to follow?
But the warrior, he becomes the light.
He doesn't walk with crowds, he doesn't speak to be heard.
He moves like a shadow but burns like a star.
He doesn't chase power, he carries purpose.
When the sky collapsed, he didn't run.
He stood still, so others could rise.
You won't see him celebrated, you'll see him standing when no one else will.
They thought the darkness would win, but they didn't account for him.
The one who doesn't beg for light, because he became it.
He fights not to conquer, but to protect what's sacred.
He doesn't speak of hope, he embodies it.
So when you hear nothing, but feel everything shift, that's him.
The warrior with no title, no crown, no audience, only mission.
In a world drowning in shadows, he walks forward.
Because the light was never afraid of the dark.
